sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Steady Signal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings. I have a job for you. There are several weather stations scattered throughout the Priozersk forest. Back when things were still normal, they monitored atmospheric conditions. To keep them running continuously, they were equipped with independent power supplies. Now they're just sitting there, rusting away. I doubt anyone will object if I put those power supplies to better use. There's just one problem: nobody knows exactly where all the stations are. You spend plenty of time in that forest, so find one and mark it with a strobe marker. I'll pay you for the work, don't worry."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Mark any of the weather stations with an MS2000 Marker on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"The signals are already coming through. My people are on their way to the forest. Here's your payment."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item Name | Amount | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 1 | This item is placed at the weather stations. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is placed on the weather stations. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |
In this quest you have to mark any weather station on Woods with an MS2000 Marker.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
- It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
- The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
